ranked_facts.concept_key: unilateral purulent discharge mixed with blood
ranked_facts.why: The presence of unilateral purulent discharge mixed with blood is more likely to be associated with an infectious process, such as acute bacterial sinusitis, rather than an anatomical obstruction, inflammatory process, or neoplastic process, as these conditions would not typically present with such a specific combination of symptoms.

ranked_facts.concept_key: new symptoms: nasal discharge with worsening pain
ranked_facts.why: The development of new symptoms, including nasal discharge and worsening pain, is more consistent with an infectious process, such as a bacterial superinfection, rather than an inflammatory process or neoplastic process, which would not typically present with such acute symptoms.
